artworks.title: Virgin and Child with Martyrs
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 27.1 x 20.2 cm (10 11/16 x 7 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows several figures. Two main figures are in the center: a young child standing on a cloud holding a branch, and an adult seated next to the child. Another figure is kneeling in front of them stretching out arms. In the background, other draped figures are sitting against architectural elements and trees. Above the central figures, cherubic faces emerge from the clouds, forming a halo-like formation. The scene is set in a classical, ethereal environment depicted in detailed engraving style.

artworks.title: Lucas van Leyden
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a seated position, facing forward with his upper body visible. He has defined facial features, medium-length straight hair, and wears a distinctive cap. He is dressed in a textured robe with wide lapels and holds an object in his left hand. The background consists of engraved lines. Below the portrait, there is a panel with a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia
artworks.artist: Remi-Henri-Joseph Delvaux after Johann Heinrich Ramberg
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the upper half of a man seated inside an oval frame that is part of a larger rectangular composition. The man is positioned in profile, facing to the right. He has white hair, a tricorn hat with a white plume, and wears a military uniform with an epaulette and a star-shaped medal on his chest. The background includes a laurel wreath above the oval frame and items below it, such as an open book, a sheathed sword, and crossed pistols. There is text at the bottom stating "FREDERIC II Roi de Prusse." The overall color scheme is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia
artworks.artist: Nicolas Delaunay after Johann Heinrich Ramberg
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of Frederick II, King of Prussia, displaying his upper body, from the chest up. He is positioned in a three-quarter view, facing to his left. His facial features are detailed, with a prominent nose and a somewhat stern expression, framed by his white, wavy hair that peeks out from under his hat. On his head, he wears a tricorn hat adorned with a ribbon or decorative piece and a plume on the side. His attire includes a high-collared coat with multiple buttons and an elaborate star-shaped insignia on his chest. The background features an oval frame with a crosshatched pattern. Beneath the portrait, there is text providing his name and title, "Frédéric II, Roi de Prusse." The entire portrait is set within a rectangular border composed of fine lines.

artworks.title: Francis II, Holy Roman Emperor
artworks.description: This is an engraving depicting a man from the waist up. The man is facing left and is wearing a high-collared coat with elaborate designs. His facial features include a pronounced nose, thin lips, and forward-gazing eyes. His hairstyle is characteristic of the 18th century, with neatly combed back hair tied at the nape of his neck with a ribbon. The image includes a large oval frame with laurel leaves and an inscription identifying the person as "FRANCISCUS I D G. ROM. IMP. HUNG. ET BOH. REX. ARCHID. AUS." A decorative crown tops the frame, while below sits a cushion displaying a crown, a scepter, and a sword. A large bird, possibly an eagle, is on the right side of the frame. The background has a cross-hatched pattern, and the base of the bust features an inscription in Latin.

artworks.title: Leopold II, Holy Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body portrait with light-colored, neatly styled hair, a serious expression, and elaborate clothing. He is adorned with badges and sashes, standing within an oval frame with inscriptions, an eagle above, and ornamental script below. The backdrop includes curtains and intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Marie-Thérèse, Holy Roman Empress
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait featuring the upper half of a woman facing the viewer. Her head is slightly turned to her left, with a fair complexion and soft facial features. She has curly, voluminous hair styled high, adorned with a decorative headpiece. She wears clothing with ruffles around the neckline and a decorative ribbon across her shoulder. The portrait is framed with garland decorations made of flowers, and below it is an inscription with her name and titles.

artworks.title: Louis XVI, Marie-Antoinette, and Louis-Charles
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of three figures in an oval frame. The central figure is a young boy with short curly hair, wearing a ruffled shirt. Behind him, a woman on the left has an elaborate hairstyle and wears a dress with a ruffled collar, possibly adorned with jewelry. To her right is a man with combed-back hair, dressed in a patterned outfit. The frame is ornate with flowers and foliage motifs, along with ancient Roman or Greek architectural elements. Below the portrait is a rectangular cartouche with text quoting Seneca. The background features a textured design.

artworks.title: Johann-Michael Denis
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man identified as Michael Denis. He is depicted in a left-facing profile within an oval frame, wearing a formal coat and high-collared shirt with detailed neckwear. Surrounding the oval are decorative elements like foliage, branches, and musical instruments. Below the oval is a scroll with the word "Aegale" and additional text. The background features more decorative elements, all rendered in black and white linework typical of an engraved illustration, with textual details underneath the portrait.

artworks.title: Marie-Thérèse, Holy Roman Empress
artworks.description: The image shows a woman depicted in a profile portrait within an oval frame. She faces to the left, displaying delicate features and an intricate hairstyle typical of the period. She wears a draped garment, and the oval frame is adorned with floral decorations and a classical motif at the top. Below the portrait is a plaque with text listing her noble titles. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed engraving and floral decorations.

artworks.title: Henri IV, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows an illustrated portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man is seated facing forward in the image, depicted from the shoulders up. He has a short, curly beard and mustache, along with curly silver or light gray hair. He wears a laurel wreath on his head, a high-collared shirt, armor on his shoulders, and a sash draped across his chest. There are no objects or jewelry in the illustration. The background has lines that enhance the portrait, and below the image is a coat of arms and decorative text.

artworks.title: Plutarch
artworks.description: The image shows an older man with a white beard and prominent facial features seated at a desk with books. He wears a robe and a head wrap, and a textured background surrounds him. An ornate border with Greek script encircles the figure.

artworks.title: Étienne Pasquier
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with only the upper portion of his body visible, inside an oval frame. He is facing forward, with his head slightly tilted to his left. The man has distinct facial features including a full, curly beard and mustache, with short curly hair peeking from under a dark cap. He wears an attire consisting of a collared garment with visible layering of fabrics. There are no visible jewelry or objects he is holding. The background is a detailed engraved oval frame with inscriptions surrounding it, complemented by floral decorations at the top corners. The image is rendered in an illustrative, engraved style typical of historical portraits.

artworks.title: Guillaume du Vair
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man, shown from the chest upwards. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left. The man has distinct facial features, including a pronounced nose and a long beard. His hair is styled back and relatively short. He is wearing a coat with a large fur collar over clothing that includes a high, white collar visible around his neck. The portrait is enclosed within an oval frame adorned with scrollwork and a crown above the man's head. There is intricate engraving surrounding the frame. Latin text is inscribed below the image. The background is simple, emphasizing the portrait and the decorative frame.

artworks.title: René Descartes
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.4 x 13.8 cm (7 5/8 x 5 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting sideways on a chair with one arm resting on a table. He has long hair, a mustache, arched eyebrows, and is dressed in formal attire. The chair has turned legs and a low back, and the table is covered with a patterned cloth. The man holds a quill, with books on the table and floor, and a shelf of books behind him. A round-topped hat is on the table to the left, and the background has vertical lines.

artworks.title: Louis de Blois
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust of a man shown from the chest up in a classic three-quarter view. He has a serious expression, with a high forehead, deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and is wearing a hooded robe. He is holding a quill pen in his right hand, poised over an open book with Latin text. Books are visible on a shelf in the background. The scene is framed by an ornate oval border with floral ornaments and decorative scrolls, and Latin inscriptions provide context around the frame.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.description: The image is a bust-length portrait. The individual is positioned facing the viewer. They have a rounded face, almond-shaped eyes, a closed mouth, and their hair is covered by a large headpiece. They are wearing a dark garment with a high collar and a geometric pattern, featuring a wide collar extending over their shoulders. The background has a pattern of fleur-de-lis symbols. The border around the image is oval, framing the figure centrally. There is text identifying the individual as Anne d'Autriche, Queen Regent of France and Navarre.

artworks.title: Louis XIV
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 16 x 11.6 cm (6 5/16 x 4 9/16 in.)
overall: 27.9 x 17.8 cm (11 x 7 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a young male figure with wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He is dressed in a garment with lace details and intricate embroidery. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with two heraldic crests at the top corners. The background has a textured pattern typical of engraved portraits.

artworks.title: Jean Le Feron
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man showing his bust, with his upper torso visible. He is positioned facing slightly to his right while looking directly at the viewer. The man has a prominent mustache and a voluminous hairstyle that falls to his shoulders, characterized by loose curls. He is dressed in traditional attire, including a large collar and a buttoned doublet or coat. The fabric appears richly textured. Around his neck, there appears to be a decorative bow or tie. The man is not shown wearing any jewelry or holding any objects. In the background, behind the man’s right shoulder, there is a scene depicting hunting or a countryside landscape, including trees and a running animal. The top corners of the image feature decorative elements, with a coat of arms in the top left and a laurel wreath emblem on the top right. The border of the image is oval-shaped.

artworks.title: Louis XIII, King of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in ornate armor with long curly hair, a prominent mustache, and a pointed beard. He is positioned slightly turned to the left, looking directly at the viewer with a neutral expression. His hand rests on a baton, and a cross of the Order is visible on his chest. The background depicts a scene that seems like a battle or military camp, with clouds and distant landscape elements. The portrait is framed in an oval shape.

artworks.title: Philippe Emmanuel, Count of Ligneville
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body facing slightly to the side, with his head turned toward the viewer. He has a mustache, goatee, and curly hair falling over his shoulders. The man wears ornate armor with a cloth draped over one shoulder. In the background, there is an oval-shaped frame with a textured backdrop and a tassel. A crest is in the top left corner, and a decorative wreath in the top right corner. Text below the portrait identifies him as Philippe Emanuel, Comte de Ligniville.

artworks.title: Jacques de la Force
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in an ornate frame. The man is seated, facing the viewer. He has a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, a mustache extending into a short, full beard, curly shoulder-length hair styled back, and is wearing an elaborate ruff around his neck. He is draped in a detailed garment, suggesting wealth or status. In the background, there is a scene of battle with smoke, figures on horseback, buildings, and a tassel near the top of the frame.

artworks.title: Louis XIV, King of France
artworks.description: The image depicts an ornate portrait showing an upper-body view of a seated young person. The individual has long, curled hair, a smooth face, slightly arched eyebrows, and a direct gaze. They are dressed in an elaborate garment with a large decorative bow on the shoulder and a richly adorned cloak fastened by a brooch. The person is holding a staff or scepter in their right hand, and a crown is placed on a small table to their left. The background includes architectural elements and a cityscape with sailing vessels. An oval frame with intricate details surrounds the portrait.

artworks.title: Anne of Austria
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait from the waist up of a woman. She is positioned slightly to the side, looking towards the viewer. Her facial features include full lips, a straight nose, and arched eyebrows. Her hair is styled in tight curls that fall around her shoulders. She is dressed in an elaborate gown with an ornate bodice adorned with jewels and fine details. A necklace made of pearls is visible around her neck, and she wears a matching pair of earrings. The backdrop is a draped fabric with a pattern of fleur-de-lis, and to the top left, there is an emblem with a crown. The background also includes a cloud-like design.
